status: Design proposal. Local fine shares, densities, age/condition are unverified authoring fixtures, not registration statistics.

materials.surfacePolicy: Simplified matte albedo fields. Recesses and trim are selective geometry; no photo textures, brick grain, asphalt noise, pores or procedural dirt.
materials.glass: Restrained dark panes with broad reflections; no mirrored photographic panorama.
materials.foliage: Irregular organic lobed crowns, selective silhouette detail; no repeated spherical clusters, no dense leaf microgeometry.
materials.detailLevel: Real proportions and silhouette; selective structural detail, simplified surface information.

peopleVehicles.policy: Near-photoreal generic form under the same matte lighting, no brands, detailed faces, readable signage or insignia.

distanceBands.people: Real anatomy, gait, clothing folds at broad scale; non-identifying facial planes, no detailed features.
distanceBands.vehicles: Real class proportions, wheels, broad glass and panel forms; no badge, identifying grille or plate text.

distanceBands.people: Natural pose and clothing colour groups; facial detail removed.
distanceBands.vehicles: Silhouette, wheel placement, glass groups; merge small trim.

distanceBands.people: Natural uninflated silhouette and muted colour groups.
distanceBands.vehicles: Real class silhouette, subdued broad glazing, no trim.

distanceBands.policy: Cull ambient actors below visibility threshold; never inflate actors.

peopleVehicles.selection: Projected size determines detail; metre bands are illustrative and depend on FOV, viewport and camera.

units.density: simultaneous visible vehicles per100m road, both curbs or all moving lanes total, NOT hourly traffic flow

taxonomy.body: Mutually exclusive; kei takes precedence over visual body shape; hatchbackEstate includes wagons; SUVs include crossovers. Buses, heavy trucks and motorcycles outside this kit.
taxonomy.EV: BEV powertrain overlay across eligible body types, not a separate body share; not all EVs have distinctive silhouettes. HEV/PHEV excluded from BEV overlay.
taxonomy.keiOutsideJapan: 0 means no default spawning, not legal prohibition.
taxonomy.colour: Eight finish families; paint hex chosen for matte shading, not measured pigment

plateRenderPolicy: Plain shape/colour only. No text,numbers,flags,seals,badges,agency markings or jurisdiction art. This is world artwork, not a road-legal plate specification.
densityStatus: All proposed; no local traffic/parking counters imported
densityFormula: Total visible parked = baseline total * region parked scale * local-hour parked multiplier * length/100; split curb/offstreet by regional parking fixture (alley curb=0), then clamp to actual visible mapped spaces. Moving = moving baseline * moving scale * moving multiplier * length/100.

capacityRules.fallback: If restrictions unresolved, leave curb clear rather than invent parking.
capacityRules.angledPolicy: Only mapped marked angle bays; slope alone never rotates bay.
capacityRules.jamPolicy: Separate observed congestion mode; do not overlap collision hulls to meet density target
capacityRules.oneWayPolicy: Follow map; region side does not override one-way lanes

snow.movingVehiclePolicy: Never block driving windows; snow caps primarily parked cars; moving residual controlled by travel/melt history

materials.dirtPolicy: Broad smooth lower-body masks, no noise/photographic dirt; apply wetness once. Require recent wet travel, salt treatment, snowfall or dry-dust travel as appropriate, plus last-wash/melt history; geographic identity alone never adds dirt.

condition.status: Unverified default aesthetic mix shared across regions; no region-specific damage stereotype
condition.ageRendering: Broad body generations and finish ageing; all bands use same unbranded design grammar, no manufacturer-specific decade cues.

detailTiers.show: Wheels, mirrors, body class, restrained lamps/glass, broad condition mask; no badges/plates/trim branding
Body silhouette, wheels and glass groups; no small trim; merge state masks
Class silhouette and finish colour group; no dirt/snow microdetail
Cull ambient cars; do not enlarge them to remain visible
